summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future: the full packet gives the OI and the five-level book with the previous close; an empty book clears every level; a packet after the close keeps close as the previous close.

deviations.reason: The web's Dhan adapter sends data.mode its own way (the subscription mode number, or no key); the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).

The web sends Dhan's trade time in epoch seconds as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends ltt in ms and Dhan's last_trade_time in seconds, as the web does.
deviations.ref: dhan_adapter.py:900; feed::dialect (Dhan last_trade_time in seconds, openalgo#2377)

deviations.reason: The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest; the web's Dhan adapter sends oi only. Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
The web sends Dhan's OI day high; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web sends Dhan's OI day low; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web sends Dhan's previous OI from the previous-close packet; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web sends Dhan's book depth (5); the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web sends the packet's day close (nonzero only after the market closes) as day_close beside the previous close; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
